name: Garden Plot Puzzle
task:
Please complete the following four-stage logic puzzle task in order.

A community garden has six plots in a row. Six gardeners plant different vegetables (tomato, carrot, lettuce, pepper, cucumber, bean). Extract these facts:
- The tomato is planted to the left of the carrot
- The lettuce is at one end of the row
- The pepper is exactly three plots from the cucumber
- The bean is not adjacent to the tomato
- The carrot is two plots right of the lettuce

Apply these additional constraints:
- The pepper is between the tomato and the cucumber
- The bean is planted at an even-numbered plot
- The lettuce and the cucumber are not adjacent
- The tomato is at plot 3
- The carrot is not at plot 6

Eliminate impossible vegetable-plot assignments. Cross-reference to narrow down.

Output each plot's vegetable. Verify all constraints.
